notes: Call with Dana, 20 min. She wants to grow by buying machine shops like ours and running them together - bigger volume, cheaper material buys, sell our assemblies to their customers. Precision CNC machining, tight-tolerance metal parts. Has to be close enough to drive to: Ohio, Indiana or Michigan. Size: roughly $10M to $30M in revenue, anything smaller is not worth the effort. Must already hold AS9100 or at least ISO 9001, we cannot wait a year for certification. Only founder or family owned, she does not want to bid against or buy from private equity. Would love it if they already sell to aerospace or defense, and if they have 5-axis machines. Best case is an owner near retirement with nobody to hand it to. On money: keep at least $1.5M cash in the bank, no more than 3x debt to EBITDA after the deal, we already carry $9M of debt.
